title: Track session content labels and host-controlled releases
summary: Grants gain optional clearances; a grant without them clears no labels, so existing hosts keep working for unlabelled sessions. All session hand-overs enforce current root-profile authority and accumulated content labels, including retries and no-work advances. Hosts can label operation results and replies, enforce labels atomically through admission, and authorize deterministic releases whose cleared output crosses a boundary without exposing private session history. Journal replay and runner evidence preserve labels and release provenance.
